notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
